name: CKEditor 5 Bookmark
project_description:
CKEditor 5 Bookmark enables the native Bookmark plugin for editing bookmarks (a.k.a. anchor links) which is included, but not enabled, in Drupal ^10.4 and ^11.1.

 
 As of version 1.3.0 , CKEditor 5 Plugin Pack also provides support for Bookmarks. You should use the Plugin Pack if you need any of it's other features.

 CKEditor5 Bookmark will remain available for those who don't need the Plugin Pack's additional features.

 
 Features 
 CKEditor 5 Bookmark provides the config and support necessary to enable and use the bookmark plugin provided by the core CKEditor assets.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing and enabling the module, visit any CKEditor 5-based text format ( /admin/config/content/formats/manage ), drag the bookmark icon from 'Available buttons' to your 'Active toolbar' and save the updated configuration.

 

 Additional Requirements 
 None. This module uses the bookmark plugin provided in the core CKEditor assets.

 Similar projects 
 
 CKEditor Anchor Link leverages a third-party plugin to provide similar functionality. 
 CKEditor 5 Plugin Pack added support for the Bookmark plugin in version 1.3.0.
